text: Predeclare a timing-only supplemental comparable-budget lane after v3 finishes. For each of the same three observed pairs, take the recorded fine-level iteration-time prefixes of SyN 100/70/40 and add its measured noniteration overhead (complete nonlinear+geometry time minus final iteration clock). Choose the observed prefix nearest the HalfFlow time in absolute log ratio, without reading anatomy or geometry values for selection. Freeze the resulting per-pair fine iteration caps and exact identities before new fits, then rerun SyN with 100/70/<chosen cap> sequentially. Predictions only choose the experiment: fresh measured ratios must still lie [0.8,1.25], otherwise report no comparable lane. This adds no interpolated quality claim and is not the strong converged reference. All original v3 points remain reported. Three selection/parsing tests pass; algorithm is in benchmarks/halfflow/reference/matched_budget.py. The five analytic tests of the existing common cell-topology helper also pass; that necessary evaluator dependency will be included with the new audit tools when published.
